title: Keeps ice frozen for 24+ hours!
review_text: Took this on a weekend camping trip in Utah and the ice was still solid the next afternoon. Zero leaks in my backpack.

title: Great daily gym bottle
review_text: Love the powder coat finish—never sweats on my desk and fits nicely in my gym bag side pocket.

title: Solid build quality, slightly heavy
review_text: Very sturdy steel construction. Only docking one star because the 32 oz size is a bit bulky for standard car cup holders.

title: Best bottle I have owned
review_text: Bought two for my kids' soccer practice. Easy to clean straw lid and no metallic taste at all.

title: Paint chipped after two washes
review_text: The insulation works fine, but the red coating started peeling near the rim after just one week of hand washing.

title: Lid leaks on the Crimson Red model
review_text: Terrible seal on the lid. Ruined my notebook inside my work bag. Looks like a bad batch on the red 32 oz version.

title: Decent bottle for the price
review_text: Keeps water cold, though the handle squeaks a little when carrying it full.

title: Red finish flakes off easily
review_text: Same issue as other buyers—the Crimson Red paint is defective and flakes off onto your hands. Avoid this color.

title: Sage Green is gorgeous and leakproof
review_text: No issues whatsoever with the green 24 oz. Fits my cup holder and keeps tea piping hot all morning.

title: Returning the Red 32 oz immediately
review_text: Arrived with scratches right out of the box and the lid threads do not catch properly.

title: Great value compared to bigger brands
review_text: Performs just as well as bottles twice the price. Very happy with the Midnight Black finish.

title: Works great, fast delivery
review_text: Good everyday water bottle. Straw cleans easily with the included brush.
